ai_summary: AGS Transact Technologies Limited, currently undergoing a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP), disclosed that its Committee of Creditors has approved a tie-breaker formula for resolution plans and, critically, extended the CIRP period by 60 days. This extension indicates a delay in finalizing a resolution, prolonging uncertainty for stakeholders and potentially increasing administrative costs, signaling a material red flag regarding the timely conclusion of the insolvency process.
